function: Online subframe-based symbol detection in the delay-Doppler domain of OTFS with a two-dimensional reservoir computing network (p. 1, 6).
system: Single OTFS link (RCP-OTFS and CP-OTFS), M=1024 subcarriers, N=14, 15 kHz spacing, 4 GHz carrier; no RIS; antenna count not stated (p. 5, 10).
method: Reservoir computing (RNN with fixed random reservoir, 2D circular padding and filtering); output weights fitted by least squares online per subframe from pilots; supervised (p. 7-9).
data_channel: Simulated 3GPP 5G NR CDL-C channel (TR 38.901), 10 ns delay spread, 150 km/h; no offline dataset, each subframe learns from its own pilots (p. 6, 10).
test_conditions: Trained on block pilots (4.69% overhead) and tested on data symbols of the same subframe; sweeps of QPSK/16QAM, OTFS variant, speed, LDPC coding (p. 6, 10-12).
baselines: Learned: 1D-RC. Classical: MPA, LSMR-based detector, LMMSE, all with estimated CSI; LMMSE-OFDM (p. 11).
metrics: BER, BLER (LDPC-coded), training and testing NMSE, number of complex multiplications per subframe (p. 10-13).
complexity: Big-O training and testing complexity (Sec. V, Tab. II); testing O((Ni+Nn)MN); complex multiplications versus block size, lower than MPA and LSMR, higher than 1D-RC (p. 9-10, 13).
q1_support: p. 10: "3GPP 5G NR clustered delay line (CDL) channel with delay profile" (CDL-C); its reference [45] is TR 38.901 (p. 16).
q2_support: p. 6: "the training dataset within one subframe" is built from the pilots and tested on the data symbols of the same subframe; no model trained in one scenario is tested in another.
q3_support: p. 11: "2D-RC is demonstrated to have better performance" than the learned 1D-RC, and it outperforms "i.e., LMMSE, MPA, and the LSMR-based approach"; both comparisons are on BER.
q4_support: p. 9: "The total training complexity is" given as an order, with testing O((Ni+Nn)MN); p. 13: "the total number of complex multiplications for one OTFS subframe" (Fig. 14).
q5_support: p. 10: "3GPP 5G NR clustered delay line (CDL) channel" is simulated; the paper gives no code or data link, no public dataset and no measurements.
notes: Title on p. 1 matches the DOI. Area 4 because the learned method detects OTFS symbols in the delay-Doppler domain. q2 is borderline: the output weights are refitted per subframe from pilots, so the speed, modulation and OTFS-variant sweeps (p. 11-12) are retraining for each condition. q1 rests on CDL-C of TR 38.901.
